title: Too Long
content:
goodness me, it's been too long since the last post. i don't have an excuse, i really just didnt feel like making any /shrug
it's been so long that the update to the site that will add this post also adds nearly 150 more splashes, and we have over 1000 now! this update also adds colors to the tabs, so if you have a browser that supports colored tabs, the ones for this site will be amber

i got my Dark Horse back in September of 2023 and have been absolutely loving it. so much fun! i have also been messing around with AI including ChatGPT, Google Bard/Gemini, Microsoft Bing/Copilot, and image generators like Stable Diffusion, NovelAI, and Dall-E 3

there has also been a change of plans, i will not be attending Vancoufur 2024. i was able to book some rooms before they were all filled, but i didnt book enough days, and the cost of the hotel, driving ~26 hours, and all that plus the fact it looked like i was only going to be able to stay 2 days made me realize it really is not worth the trouble. maybe next year, if i plan better!

lastly i am working on upgrading my PC! my current PC has an i9 9900K and RTX 2080 with 64GB of RAM, and i want to upgrade to a Ryzen 9 7950X3D and RTX 4090 with 128GB of RAM. i'll be sure to make certain the cable for the graphics card is seated all the way!

going back to the Mustang, you can follow everything i'm doing to it at this link
Forum Thread
that link goes to my forum topic on Mustang7G, which lists everything i have planned or done to it

well, i think that's it for now!
i'll see you guys next time i have something to say!
